deploy.startCommand: cd packages/db && (npx prisma migrate status 2>&1 || { echo '=== Failed migration detected ==='; echo 'Recovery (run via railway ssh --service backend):'; echo '  1. npx prisma migrate resolve --rolled-back "<failed-migration-name>"'; echo '  2. npx prisma db execute --file /tmp/fix.sql'; echo '  3. npx prisma migrate resolve --applied "<failed-migration-name>"'; echo 'See docs/wiki/config/database-setup.md for the full procedure'; exit 1; }) && npx prisma migrate deploy && cd ../../backend && node src/api/server.js
